text: SREE JESSU Analyst AI & Engineering Deloitte Consulting LLP Tel: (629) 935-9790 sjessu@deloitte.com Office: Chicago sree-jessu-portfolio.vercel.app in linkedin.com/in/sree-jessu Professional Summary Sree Jessu is an Analyst with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of Waterloo. Prior to joining the firm, she interned at BlackBerry, where she automated workflows supporting 65,000+ annual requests and led a compliance initiative that earned recognition from senior IT leadership. She has since built several independent tools that apply AI to real-world business problems across financial, government, and healthcare settings. Sree is known for breaking down complex problems into clear, practical solutions, and communicating them effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Previous Experience BlackBerry Jan 2023 - April 2023 Software Development and Cybersecurity Project Management Intern Waterloo, ON - Automated business workflows using C#, Active Directory, and SQL Server, optimizing processing for 65,000+ annual requests and improving operational efficiency. - Led a SOC2 compliance initiative in collaboration with cybersecurity leadership, achieving a 90% compliance rating and strengthening audit readiness. - Coordinated penetration testing and vulnerability assessments aligned with IT audit standards and incident response protocols. - Developed weekly security metrics and dashboards used by the CISO and VP of IT to support executive decision-making. - Improved identity and access management for 100+ employees through PowerShell automation and Active Directory scripting. - Prepared executive-level documentation and presentations translating complex technical findings into clear insights for the CIO and CISO.
